This category is part of the Wookieepedia multilingual coordination project.

To mark your skill in the [[Wikipedia:{{LangCode|mode=name|{{{1}}}}} language|{{LangCode|mode=name|{{{1}}}}} language]], put the following onto your user page:

:<tt><nowiki>{{Lang|</nowiki>{{{1}}}<nowiki>|level}}</nowiki></tt>

where "level" stands for:
* '''0''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|0}}
* '''1''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|1}}
* '''2''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|2}}
* '''3''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|3}}
* '''4''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|4}}
* '''U''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|U}}
* '''E''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|E}}
* '''F''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|F}}
* '''N''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|N}}
* '''P''' - {{LangText|{{{1}}}|P}}

Please do not use more than one level for any one language.
